entities.summary:
Marmara Island is a Turkish island in the Sea of Marmara. With an area of 126.1 km2 (48.7 sq mi), it is the largest island in the Sea of Marmara and the second-largest island of Turkey - after Gökçeada. It is the center of Marmara District in Balıkesir Province. Ships and ferries provide transportation from Istanbul, and motorboats from Tekirdağ and Erdek. Marmara Island has a lot of historical artifacts. The town of Marmara
on the island's south-western coast takes its name from the quarried marble for which the town is famous and which gives the island, the sea and the whole region their names.
